neet_phy_u02_t01_1.working: Velocity is the slope of the x-t graph: (14 - 2)/(4 - 0) = 3 m/s.

neet_phy_u02_t01_2.working: Velocity falls uniformly, so it is zero at t = 2 s. Distance = 1/2·2·10 + 1/2·2·10 = 20 m. Displacement is 0 but distance is 20 m.

neet_phy_u02_t01_3.working: Change in velocity = area under a-t graph = 3·4 + (-2)·2 = 8. Final velocity = 2 + 8 = 10 m/s.

neet_phy_u02_t01_4.working: x-t slope gives velocity, v-t slope gives acceleration, v-t area gives displacement, a-t area gives change in velocity. So A-III, B-I, C-IV, D-II.

neet_phy_u02_t01_5.working: A true (constant x means rest). B false (v-t is a straight line for uniform acceleration). C true (concave up means positive acceleration). D true (v changes sign where it crosses the axis). E false (signed area gives displacement, not distance). So A, C, D.
